name: target-address-refused

graded_by.test: owed by the E3 worker plan
owed by the E3 core plan

description: The worker resolves connect.host once. It refuses an address in its deployment's deny list with error target_address_refused, naming the target id and never the address; an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address is checked as the IPv4 address it maps. It then connects to the address it checked, so a second lookup cannot move it. No TCP connection is opened for a refused address. The core answers the create 502 target_connect_failed. The deny list is the deployment's (the worker's launch environment), never a contract value. U3 and U2 tests, owed.

msg.message: fixture-telnet-denied resolves to an address in the deployment's deny list; no connection was opened

messages.note: the message names the target id, never the address; the core answers the create 502 target_connect_failed
